text: Hold SUPPORT. I cannot see decision.json, so I cannot say which horizon was set; my position system holds more than two weeks (C22, C29), so horizon_sessions 20 or 30 both sit inside my band and my vote stands on either. The ticket should print the one the deciders filed. On my method the picture is strength, the entry signal (C26): D hh_hl_3 HH/HL, W hh_hl_3 HH/HL, D dist_to_20bar_high_pct 0.43, D last_bar green. Distance from value is a swing-system objection, not mine here. Trigger: trade_above:bar_high, trailed daily (C27). Wrong if a daily close below max(fib_swing_low, base_low_20d).
